Responses from the Plex Media Server test container (tool/test_servers) and plex.tv,
trimmed, with tokens replaced.

Written by hand, in Plex's shapes, because the container can't produce them without
a Plex account or Plex Pass: resources.json (plex.tv's server list, incl. a
relay-only shared server), home_users.json (plex.tv's Home users), and the Marker
array in metadata_markers.json (commercial markers come only from Plex DVR with
commercial detection). sections.json has a photo library added to the recorded
list.
